G4012.b:

⟪I.⟫ C. gen.,

	⟪2.⟫ Causal, ⟪about⟫, ⟪on account of⟫, ⟪concerning⟫, ⟪in reference to⟫: ⟦Matthew 2:8|Mt 2:8⟧, ⟦Mark 1:44|Mk 1:44⟧, ⟦Luke 4:38|Lk 4:38⟧, ⟦John 16:26|Jo 16:26⟧, ⟦Acts 28:21|Ac 28:21⟧, al. mult.; τὰ περί, c. gen., ⟪the things concerning⟫ one, one's state or case: ⟦Mark 5:27|Mk 5:27⟧, ⟦Acts 1:3|Ac 1:3⟧ ⟦Acts 28:15|28:15⟧, ⟦Ephesians 6:22|Eph 6:22⟧, al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, ⟪regarding⟫, ⟪as to⟫, ⟦1 Corinthians 7:1|I Co 7:1⟧, al.; in the sense ⟪on account of⟫ (⟦Matthew 26:28|Mt 26:28⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:13|I Co 1:13⟧, al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. (< πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨עוֹף⁩;] in trag., Ion. and late writers, ⟪winged⟫, ⟪flying⟫; as subst., τὸ π., ⟪a winged fowl⟫, ⟪a bird⟫: pl., ⟦Matthew 6:26|Mt 6:26⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:20|8:20⟧ ⟦Matthew 13:4|13:4⟧, ⟦Matthew 13:32|32⟧, ⟦Mark 4:4|Mk 4:4⟧, ⟦Mark 4:32|32⟧, ⟦Luke 8:5|Lk 8:5⟧ ⟦Luke 9:58|9:58⟧ ⟦Luke 12:24|12:24⟧ ⟦Luke 13:19|13:19⟧, ⟦Acts 10:12|Ac 10:12⟧ ⟦Acts 11:6|11:6⟧, ⟦Romans 1:23|Ro 1:23⟧, ⟦James 3:7|Ja 3:7⟧.†

G4072.b:
⟪πέτομαι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨עוּף⁩;] ⟪to fly⟫: ⟦Revelation 4:7|Re 4:7⟧ ⟦Revelation 8:13|8:13⟧ ⟦Revelation 12:14|12:14⟧ ⟦Revelation 14:6|14:6⟧ ⟦Revelation 19:17|19:17⟧ (Rec. πετάομαι, q.v.).†

G4073.b:
⟪πέτρα⟫, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨סֶלַע⁩, ⁨צוּר⁩;] ⟪a rock⟫, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder: ⟦Matthew 7:24|Mt 7:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 7:25|25⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:51|27:51⟧, ⟦Matthew 27:60|60⟧, ⟦Mark 15:46|Mk 15:46⟧, ⟦Luke 6:48|Lk 6:48⟧ ⟦Luke 8:6|8:6⟧, ⟦Luke 8:13|13⟧; of a hollow rock, ⟪a cave⟫, ⟦Revelation 6:15|Re 6:15⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:16|16⟧ (cf. ⟦Isaiah 2:10|Is 2:10⟧, al.). Metaph., ⟦Matthew 16:18|Mt 16:18⟧ (on the meaning, v. Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l.), ⟦1 Corinthians 10:4|I Co 10:4⟧; = πέτρος, ⟦Romans 9:33|Ro 9:33⟧, ⟦1 Peter 2:8|I Pe 2:8⟧(LXX).†
a: Commentaries on the Greek Text of the Epistle of St. James (1:1-4:7); The First Epistle of St. Peter (1:1-2:17'); and the Apocalypse of St. John (1-3), by F. J. A. Hort. Macmilian, 1898-1909

G4074.b: ⟪Πέτρος⟫, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, v.s. πέτρα, Κηφᾶς), ⟪Simon Peter⟫, the Apostle: ⟦Matthew 4:18|Mt 4:18⟧ ⟦Matthew 10:2|10:2⟧, ⟦Mark 3:16|Mk 3:16⟧, ⟦Luke 5:8|Lk 5:8⟧, ⟦John 1:41|Jo 1:41⟧, ⟦John 1:43|43⟧, al.

G4075.b:
* ⟪πετρώδης⟫, -ες
(< πέτρα, εἶδος), ⟪rock-like⟫, ⟪rocky⟫, ⟪stony⟫: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, ⟦Matthew 13:5|Mt 13:5⟧, ⟦Matthew 13:20|20⟧, ⟦Mark 4:5|Mk 4:5⟧, ⟦Mark 4:16|16⟧.†

G4077.b:
⟪πηγή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨עַיִן⁩, also for ⁨מָקוֹר⁩, etc.;] ⟪a spring⟫, ⟪fountain⟫: ⟦James 3:11|Ja 3:11⟧, ⟦2 Peter 2:17|II Pe 2:17⟧; τ. ὑδάτων, ⟦Revelation 8:10|Re 8:10⟧ ⟦Revelation 14:7|14:7⟧ ⟦Revelation 16:4|16:4⟧; of a well fed by a spring, ⟦John 4:6|Jo 4:6⟧; π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, ⟦Mark 5:29|Mk 5:29⟧; metaph., ⟦John 4:14|Jo 4:14⟧, ⟦Revelation 7:17|Re 7:17⟧ ⟦Revelation 21:6|21:6⟧.†

G4078.b:
⟪πήγνυμι⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨נטה⁩, also for ⁨תּקע⁩, etc.;] ⟪to make fast⟫, ⟪to fix⟫; of tents, ⟪to pitch⟫: ⟦Hebrews 8:2|He 8:2⟧ (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†

G4079.b:
* ⟪πηδάλιον⟫, -ου, τό
(< πηδός, the blade of an oar), ⟪a rudder⟫: ⟦James 3:4|Ja 3:4⟧; pl., ⟦Acts 27:40|Ac 27:40⟧.†

G4080.b:
⟪πηλίκος⟫, -η, -ον,
[in LXX: ⟦Zechariah 2:2|Za 2:2⟧ (⟦Zechariah 2:6|6⟧) (⁨כַּמָּה⁩), IV Mac 15:22*;] interrog., ⟪how large⟫, ⟪how great?⟫ (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (v. Bl., § 51, 4), ⟦Galatians 6:11|Ga 6:11⟧; of personal greatness, ⟦Hebrews 7:4|He 7:4⟧.†

G4081.b:
⟪πηλός⟫, οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חֹמֶר⁩, ⁨טִיט⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪clay⟫, as used by a potter: ⟦Romans 9:21|Ro 9:21⟧ (cf. ⟦Isaiah 29:16|Is 29:16⟧, al.).
⟪2.⟫ = βόρβορος, wet clay, ⟪mud⟫: ⟦John 9:6|Jo 9:6⟧, ⟦John 9:11|11⟧, ⟦John 9:14|14⟧, ⟦John 9:15|15⟧.†

G4082.b:
** ⟪πήρα⟫, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX: Jth 10:5 13:10, 15*;] ⟪a leathern pouch⟫ for victuals, etc., ⟪a wallet⟫ (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, v. LAE, 108 ff.): ⟦Matthew 10:10|Mt 10:10⟧, ⟦Mark 6:8|Mk 6:8⟧, ⟦Luke 9:3|Lk 9:3⟧ ⟦Luke 10:4|10:4⟧ ⟦Luke 22:35|22:35⟧, ⟦Luke 22:36|36⟧.†

G4083.b:
⟪πῆχυς⟫, -εως, gen. pl., -ῶν (for Att. -εων, v. WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153),
[in LXX chiefly and freq. for ⁨אַמָּה⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪the forearm⟫ (Hom.).
⟪2.⟫ As a measure of length, ⟪a cubit⟫: ⟦Matthew 6:27|Mt 6:27⟧, ⟦Luke 12:25|Lk 12:25⟧, ⟦John 21:8|Jo 21:8⟧, ⟦Revelation 21:17|Re 21:17⟧.†
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909
A Grammar of the O.T. in Greek I, by H. St. J. Thackeray. Cambridge, 1909
The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G4084.b:
⟪πιάζω⟫
(cf. MGr. πιάνω; v. Kennedy, Sources, 155), Doric and late Att. for πιέζω in its later senses; [in LXX: ⟦Song of Solomon 2:15|Ca 2:15⟧ (⁨אחז⁩), Si 23:21*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to lay hold of⟫: ⟦Acts 3:7|Ac 3:7⟧ (Theocr.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to take⟫, ⟪capture⟫, ⟪apprehend⟫: ⟦John 7:30|Jo 7:30⟧, ⟦John 7:32|32⟧, ⟦John 7:44|44⟧ ⟦John 8:20|8:20⟧ ⟦John 10:39|10:39⟧ ⟦John 11:57|11:57⟧ ⟦John 21:3|21:3⟧, ⟦John 21:10|10⟧, ⟦Acts 12:4|Ac 12:4⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:32|II Co 11:32⟧, ⟦Revelation 19:20|Re 19:20⟧ (v. MM, xx).†
a: Sources of N.T. Greek, by H. A. A. Kennedy. T. & T. Clark, 1895

G4085.b:
⟪πιέζω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦Micah 6:15|Mi 6:15⟧ (⁨דּרךְ⁩)*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to press⟫, ⟪press down⟫ or ⟪together⟫: ⟦Luke 6:38|Lk 6:38⟧ (cl).
⟪2.⟫ Later, ⟪to seize⟫ (v.s. πιάζω).†

G4086.b:
* ⟪πιθανολογία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< πιθανός, persuasive, plausible), in cl. (Plat), ⟪the use of probable arguments⟫, as opp. to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, ⟪persuasive speech⟫: ⟦Colossians 2:4|Col 2:4⟧ (v. ICC, in l.).†

G4087.b:
⟪πικραίνω⟫
(< πικρός), [in LXX for ⁨מרר⁩, ⁨קצף⁩, etc.;] ⟪to make bitter⟫: ⟦Revelation 10:9|Re 10:9⟧; pass., ⟦Revelation 8:11|Re 8:11⟧ ⟦Revelation 10:10|10:10⟧; metaph., ⟪to embitter⟫ (LXX): pass., seq. πρός, ⟦Colossians 3:19|Col 3:19⟧.†

G4089.b:
⟪πικρός⟫, -ά, -όν
(poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨מַר⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪sharp⟫, ⟪pointed⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪sharp⟫ to the senses; of taste, ⟪bitter⟫: opp. to γλυκύ, ⟦James 3:11|Ja 3:11⟧; metaph., ⟪harsh⟫, ⟪bitter⟫: ⟦James 3:14|Ja 3:14⟧.

G4090.b:
⟪πικρῶς⟫, adv.
(< πικρός), [in LXX for ⁨מַר⁩, ⁨מרר⁩ pi.;] ⟪bitterly⟫: metaph., (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., ⟦Matthew 26:75|Mt 26:75⟧, ⟦Luke 22:62|Lk 22:62⟧ (v. MM, xviii, s.v. παρακολουθέω).†

G4092.b:
⟪πίμπρημι⟫
(in cl. prose, rare in the simple form), [in LXX: ⟦Numbers 5:21|Nu 5:21⟧, ⟦Numbers 5:22|22⟧, ⟦Numbers 5:27|27⟧ (⁨צָבֶה⁩)*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to blow⟫, ⟪burn⟫.
⟪2.⟫ Later, ⟪to cause to swell⟫; mid., of parts of the body, ⟪to become swollen⟫ (LXX): ⟦Acts 28:6|Ac 28:6⟧ (cf. ἐμπίπρημι).†

G4093.b:
** ⟪πινακίδιον⟫, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πινακίς, q.v.), [in Sm.: ⟦Ezekiel 9:2|Ez 9:2⟧*;] ⟪a writing tablet⟫: ⟦Luke 1:63|Lk 1:63⟧.†

G4095.b:
⟪πίνω⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁתה⁩;] ⟪to drink⟫: absol., ⟦Luke 2:19|Lk 2:19⟧, ⟦John 4:7|Jo 4:7⟧, al.; c. acc. rei, ⟦Matthew 6:25|Mt 6:25⟧, ⟦Matthew 6:31|31⟧, ⟦Mark 14:25|Mk 14:25⟧, al.; of habitual use, ⟦Luke 1:15|Lk 1:15⟧, ⟦Romans 14:21|Ro 14:21⟧, al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, ⟦1 Corinthians 10:21|I Co 10:21⟧, al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), ⟦Hebrews 6:7|He 6:7⟧; spiritually, of the blood of Christ, ⟦John 6:53|Jo 6:53⟧, ⟦John 6:54|54⟧, ⟦John 6:56|56⟧; seq. ἐκ (of the vessel), ⟦Matthew 26:27|Mt 26:27⟧, al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), ⟦Matthew 26:29|Mt 26:29⟧, ⟦John 4:13|Jo 4:13⟧, ⟦John 4:14|14⟧, ⟦Revelation 14:10|Re 14:10⟧, al.; ἀπό, ⟦Luke 22:18|Lk 22:18⟧ (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, ⟦Luke 17:8|Lk 17:8⟧, v. Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, Pr., 44 f., Thackeray, Gr., 63 f.).
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908
A Grammar of the O.T. in Greek I, by H. St. J. Thackeray. Cambridge, 1909

G4096.b:
⟪πιότης⟫, -ητος, ἡ
(< πίων, fat), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨דֶּשֶׁן⁩;] ⟪fatness⟫: ⟦Romans 11:17|Ro 11:17⟧.†

G4097.b:
⟪πιπράσκω⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨מכר⁩ ni.;] ⟪to sell⟫: c. acc. rei, ⟦Matthew 13:46|Mt 13:46⟧ (on this pf., v. Bl., § 59, 5), ⟦Acts 2:45|Ac 2:45⟧ ⟦Acts 4:34|4:34⟧ ⟦Acts 5:4|5:4⟧; c. gen. (of price), ⟦Matthew 26:9|Mt 26:9⟧, ⟦Mark 14:5|Mk 14:5⟧, ⟦John 12:5|Jo 12:5⟧; c. acc. pers. (of slavery), ⟦Matthew 18:25|Mt 18:25⟧; hence metaph., ⟦Romans 7:14|Ro 7:14⟧ (cf. ⟦2 Kings 17:17|IV Ki 17:17⟧, I Mac 1:15, al.).†

a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908
